positive.prompt: Sweep the codebase for real correctness bugs and prove every fix with a regression test.
Find defects users have not reported yet, reproduce each failure, and deliver one fix PR.
Do an end-to-end bug hunt, but exclude cleanup and speculative hardening.

negative.prompt: This flaky test has a known failure report; reproduce that symptom and repair its root cause.
Consolidate duplicated modules and remove dead forwarding layers without changing behavior.

evals.prompt: A reviewer suggests adding a null check but cannot name any reachable input that hits it. Decide whether it enters the defect plan.
evals.expected_output: A finding decision based on a concrete reproducible failure scenario.
expectations: The speculative null check is not accepted as a defect without a reachable failure.
No fix is dispatched until a failing regression test can reproduce the behavior.
